gates.description: CPU Gate: interpreter identity challenge, structured per-tool reports, actual in-container uid, and a typed finalized artifact -- each read from evidence, not from an exit code. Exit 0 with nothing run is a FAIL.

Runs a real device workload (set_device + tensor add + synchronize + numeric check) on every device in the requested ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES list, as root inside the container, with the exact list asserted in-payload. Occupancy is read ONCE and recorded as non-verdict metadata; busy and idle run the same workload, with the same verdict rule. No busy wait, poll, skip, fallback, or exclusive refusal exists. BLOCKED_ENV is reserved for real faults: missing root, unreadable/failed npu-smi, health not OK, requested device not bound into the container, or authentication failure.

ordering.observedFailure: Without CANN sourced first: ImportError: libhccl.so: cannot open shared object file, from torch_npu/npu/utils.py importing torch_npu._C. With CANN sourced first: torch_npu 2.12.0 imports, exit 0. Both directions observed.
traps: set_env.sh breaks under set -u (expands unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH, PYTHONPATH, CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH)

busyDevicePolicy.default: RECORD occupancy once and PROCEED. All Ascend cards are shared; busy is non-verdict metadata. Busy and idle run the same workload with the same verdict rule.
busyDevicePolicy.refusalSet: ONLY real faults: missing root/auth/lock, unreadable/failed npu-smi, health not OK, requested device not bound into the container.
busyDevicePolicy.ordering: Occupancy is read before torch_npu is imported, so a health fault is reported before a device node opens; the read is not an admission test.
busyDevicePolicy.legacy: TF_ALLOW_BUSY_DEVICE and TF_REQUIRE_EXCLUSIVE are RETIRED and ignored; neither can change dispatch, selection, verdict, retry, or skip.
busyDevicePolicy.superseded: A prior policy refused a held card by default and required TF_ALLOW_BUSY_DEVICE=1 to share. That is abrogated and must not be restored.
